name: Qing dynasty

flag.description: A yellow field with a blue dragon stretched across it, its head turned towards a red pearl in the upper hoist corner.
flag.symbolism: Yellow was the imperial color of the Qing, and the dragon was the symbol of the emperor.

hook: Qing China's Yellow Dragon Flag has a blue dragon chasing a red pearl across a yellow field; Bhutan's dragon is white and lies on a yellow-and-orange diagonal.
trivia: The Yellow Dragon Flag was first triangular and was made rectangular in 1889.
It was China's first national flag, created when the Qing navy needed an ensign for dealings with foreign powers.
